SELECT frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
INNER JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOCType LIKE 'Continuation%'
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.School
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE st.NumTstTakr > 500 AND s.Magnet = 1

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500
SELECT T2.District FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.StatusType = 'Active' GROUP BY T2.District ORDER BY AVG(T1.AvgScrRead) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools 
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds 
WHERE schools.StatusType = 'Merged' 
  AND schools.County = 'Alameda' 
  AND satscores.NumTstTakr < 100

SELECT schools.CharterNum, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS rank
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND schools.CharterNum IS NOT NULL

SELECT T2.School, T2.FundingType
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.cname = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY T2.School, T2.FundingType
HAVING SUM(T1.AvgScrMath) / COUNT(*) > 400

SELECT T3.School, T3.Street, T3.City, T3.State, T3.Zip
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T3 ON T1.CDSCode = T3.CDSCode
WHERE T3.County = 'Monterey'
  AND T1."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800
  AND T1."High Grade" = '12';

SELECT T2.School, T2.DOCType
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally Funded'
  AND T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > (
      SELECT AVG(T3.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T3.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm AS T3
      JOIN schools AS T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode
      WHERE T4.FundingType = 'Locally Funded'
  )
SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS `Eligible Free Rate (K-12)` FROM frpm ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9

SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` 
FROM schools AS T1 
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson'

SELECT T1.AdmEmail1
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
ORDER BY T2."Enrollment (K-12)" ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(T2.NumTstTakr)
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.OpenDate) = '1980'
  AND T1.County = 'Fresno'

SELECT T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.City
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.School FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.DOC = 31 ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT T2.sname, T1.MailStreet FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds ORDER BY T2.AvgScrMath DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.CDSCode)
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T2.AvgScrRead + T2.AvgScrMath + T2.AvgScrWrite >= 1500
  AND T1.MailCity = 'Lakeport'

SELECT Website FROM schools
WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez');
SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE Virtual = 'P' AND Charter = 1 AND City = 'San Joaquin'

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode) FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Los Angeles' AND T2.Charter = 0 AND T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman' AND CharterNum = '00D4'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE FundingType = 'Directly Funded' AND County = 'Stanislaus' AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31'

SELECT County
FROM schools
WHERE SOC = 11
  AND ClosedDate BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1989-12-31'
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY COUNT(CDSCode) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.School,
       f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" * 100.0 / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)"
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles' AND s.GSserved = 'K-9'
SELECT GSserved FROM schools WHERE City = 'Adelanto' GROUP BY GSserved ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.City, f."Low Grade", s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.State = 'CA'
ORDER BY s.Latitude ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools 
WHERE GSoffered = 'K-8' 
  AND Magnet = 1 
  AND CDSCode IN (
      SELECT CDSCode 
      FROM frpm 
      WHERE `NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types'
  )

SELECT f.`District Code`, f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine'

SELECT AdmEmail1, AdmEmail2, AdmEmail3
FROM schools
WHERE SOC = 62
  AND DOC = 54
  AND OpenDate BETWEEN '1/1/2009' AND '12/31/2010'
  AND County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND City = 'San Bernardino'
SELECT DisplayName FROM users ORDER BY Views DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT p.Title
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';
SELECT MAX(AnswerCount) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'csgillespie')

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM users u

SELECT posts.Body
FROM tags
JOIN posts ON tags.ExcerptPostId = posts.Id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges JOIN users ON badges.UserId = users.Id WHERE users.DisplayName = 'csgillespie' AND strftime('%Y', badges.Date) = '2011';
SELECT AVG(p.Score) FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE PostId IN (SELECT Id FROM posts WHERE ViewCount = 1910)

SELECT c.Text
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.ParentId = 107829
  AND p.CommentCount = 1

SELECT users.DisplayName
FROM comments
JOIN users ON comments.UserId = users.Id
WHERE comments.Text = 'thank you user93!';

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.LastEditorUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Open source tools for visualizing multi-dimensional data';
SELECT SUM(v.BountyAmount) FROM votes v JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id WHERE p.Title LIKE '%data%';

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM votes v
JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id
JOIN users u ON v.UserId = u.Id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM (
    SELECT b.UserId
    FROM badges b
    JOIN users u ON u.Id = b.UserId
    WHERE u.Location LIKE '%New York%'
      AND b.Name IN ('Teacher', 'Supporter')
    GROUP BY b.UserId
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.Name) = 2
) t;

SELECT u.Id, u.DisplayName
FROM users AS u
JOIN postHistory AS ph ON ph.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Views >= 1000
GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName
HAVING COUNT(ph.Id) = COUNT(DISTINCT ph.PostId);

SELECT u.DisplayName, b.Name
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Id IN (
    SELECT UserId
    FROM comments
    GROUP BY UserId
    HAVING COUNT(Id) = (
        SELECT MAX(cnt)
        FROM (
            SELECT COUNT(Id) AS cnt
            FROM comments
            GROUP BY UserId
        ) AS counts
    )
);

SELECT
    ph.PostHistoryTypeId,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.UserId)
     FROM comments c
     WHERE c.PostId = 3720) AS UniqueCommentingUsers
FROM postHistory ph
WHERE ph.PostId = 3720;

SELECT posts.Score, postLinks.LinkTypeId
FROM posts
JOIN postLinks ON posts.Id = postLinks.PostId
WHERE posts.Id = 395;

SELECT AVG(u.UpVotes) AS avg_up_votes,
       AVG(u.Age) AS avg_age
FROM users u
WHERE u.Id IN (
    SELECT p.OwnerUserId
    FROM posts p
    GROUP BY p.OwnerUserId
    HAVING COUNT(p.Id) > 10
);
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserId) FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Announcer'

SELECT badges.Date
FROM badges
JOIN users ON badges.UserId = users.Id
WHERE users.Location = 'Rochester, NY';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserId) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM users) FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Teacher'

SELECT c.Text
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.CreaionDate = '2010-07-19 19:37:33.0';

SELECT DISTINCT u.Age
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId

SELECT b.Name
FROM badges b

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes WHERE strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2010';
SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2010' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2011' THEN 1 END) FROM votes;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Tags
FROM posts AS T1
JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id
WHERE T2.DisplayName = 'John Salvatier';

SELECT users.DisplayName
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
WHERE users.DisplayName IN ('Harvey Motulsky', 'Noah Snyder')

ORDER BY SUM(posts.ViewCount) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserId) FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Commentator' AND strftime('%Y', Date) = '2014';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE CreaionDate BETWEEN '2010-07-21 00:00:00' AND '2010-07-21 23:59:59';
SELECT DisplayName, Age FROM users WHERE Views = (SELECT MAX(Views) FROM users);

SELECT b.Name
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Location LIKE '%North Pole%'
  AND strftime('%Y', b.Date) = '2011';

SELECT u.DisplayName, u.WebsiteUrl
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.FavoriteCount > 150;

SELECT COUNT(ph.Id) AS PostHistoryCount, p.LastEditDate
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN postHistory ph ON ph.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'What is the best introductory Bayesian statistics textbook?'

SELECT u.LastAccessDate, u.Location
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE b.Name = 'Outliers';

SELECT T1.PostId, T2.Name
FROM comments AS T1
JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.UserId
WHERE T1.UserDisplayName = 'Samuel'
  AND strftime('%Y', T1.CreationDate) = '2013'
  AND strftime('%Y', T2.Date) = '2013';
SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM tags WHERE Count BETWEEN 5000 AND 7000
SELECT OwnerUserId FROM posts WHERE FavoriteCount = (SELECT MAX(FavoriteCount) FROM posts);
SELECT Id FROM users ORDER BY Age LIMIT 1;

SELECT u.DisplayName

ORDER BY COUNT(b.Name) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT MIN(v.CreationDate) FROM votes v JOIN users u ON v.UserId = u.Id WHERE u.DisplayName = 'chl'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id WHERE users.DisplayName = 'Jay Stevens' AND strftime('%Y', posts.CreaionDate) = '2010';
SELECT Id, Title FROM posts ORDER BY Score DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.ViewCount > 20000
  AND strftime('%Y', p.CreaionDate) = '2011';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE ViewCount > (SELECT AVG(ViewCount) FROM posts)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE PostId = (SELECT Id FROM posts WHERE Score = (SELECT MAX(Score) FROM posts));
SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM posts WHERE ViewCount > 35000 AND CommentCount = 0;

SELECT b.Name, b.Date
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Emmett'
ORDER BY b.Date DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE Age BETWEEN 19 AND 65 AND UpVotes > 5000

SELECT julianday(b.Date) - julianday(u.CreationDate) AS DaysToBadge
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Zolomon';

SELECT c.Text, c.UserDisplayName
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Analysing wind data with R'
ORDER BY c.CreationDate DESC
LIMIT 10;
SELECT Count FROM tags WHERE TagName = 'careers';
SELECT Reputation, Views FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'Jarrod Dixon';

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.PostId = p.Id) AS comment_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts a WHERE a.ParentId = p.Id AND a.PostTypeId = 2) AS answer_count
FROM posts p
WHERE p.Title = 'Clustering 1D data';

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN p.Score > 50 THEN p.Id END) / COUNT(p.Id) AS percentage
FROM posts p
WHERE p.OwnerUserId = (
    SELECT Id
    FROM users
    ORDER BY Reputation DESC
    LIMIT 1
);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tags WHERE Id < 15 AND Count <= 20

SELECT c.Text
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.Title LIKE '%linear regression%';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments JOIN users ON comments.UserId = users.Id WHERE comments.Score = 0 AND users.Age = 40

SELECT T1.Text
FROM comments AS T1
JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.Id
WHERE T2.DisplayName = 'Harvey Motulsky'

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE c.Score BETWEEN 1 AND 5

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN u.UpVotes = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE c.Score BETWEEN 5 AND 10;

SELECT c.CustomerID
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
  AND y.Date BETWEEN 201201 AND 201212
GROUP BY c.CustomerID
ORDER BY SUM(y.Consumption) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM (
    SELECT y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Segment = 'KAM' 
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201201 AND 201212
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID
    HAVING SUM(y.Consumption) < 30000
)

SELECT c.Segment
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY SUM(y.Consumption) ASC
LIMIT 1;

    )

(
  SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
  FROM yearmonth AS T1
  JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
  WHERE T2.Segment = 'KAM' AND T2.Currency = 'CZK' AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    AND T1.Consumption = (
      SELECT MIN(T3.Consumption)
      FROM yearmonth AS T3
      JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
      WHERE T4.Segment = 'KAM' AND T4.Currency = 'CZK' AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312

-
(
  SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)

  JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
  WHERE T2.Segment = 'SME' AND T2.Currency = 'CZK' AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    AND T1.Consumption = (
      SELECT MIN(T3.Consumption)
      FROM yearmonth AS T3
      JOIN customers AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
      WHERE T4.Segment = 'SME' AND T4.Currency = 'CZK' AND T3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    )
) AS difference_KAM_SME;

SELECT T1.CustomerID
FROM customers AS T1
INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE T1.Segment = 'LAM'
  AND T1.Currency = 'Euro'
  AND T2.Date = '201310'
ORDER BY T2.Consumption DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(T.Consumption)
FROM yearmonth AS T
JOIN customers AS C ON T.CustomerID = C.CustomerID
WHERE C.Segment = 'KAM'
  AND T.Date = 201305
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Consumption > 46.73 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM yearmonth AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T2.Segment = 'LAM'
SELECT MAX(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) = '2012'

    SELECT SUM(yearmonth.Consumption) / 12.0 AS monthly_consumption
    FROM yearmonth
    JOIN customers ON customers.CustomerID = yearmonth.CustomerID
    WHERE customers.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY yearmonth.CustomerID
);

FROM yearmonth Y
JOIN transactions_1k T ON Y.CustomerID = T.CustomerID
JOIN products P ON T.ProductID = P.ProductID
WHERE SUBSTR(Y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' AND SUBSTR(Y.Date, 5, 2) = '09'

FROM gasstations AS T2
JOIN transactions_1k AS T1 ON T2.GasStationID = T1.GasStationID
WHERE T1.Date LIKE '201306%'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT y.CustomerID)
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND y.Consumption > 1000;
SELECT CustomerID FROM transactions_1k WHERE Date = '2012-08-25' GROUP BY CustomerID ORDER BY SUM(Price) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT g.Country
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25'
ORDER BY t.Time ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.Segment
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
ORDER BY y.Date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.Country
FROM transactions_1k AS T1
JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID
WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-24' AND T1.Time = '12:42:00'

SELECT c.Currency
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE y.Date = '201306' AND y.Consumption = 214582.17;
SELECT T2.Country FROM transactions_1k AS T1 JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-24' AND T1.Price = 548.4

FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.CustomerID, c.Currency
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25'
)
SELECT SUM(Amount * Price) FROM transactions_1k WHERE CustomerID = 38508 AND Date = '201201'

SELECT t.CustomerID, c.Currency, SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS avg_price_per_item
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY t.CustomerID, c.Currency
ORDER BY SUM(t.Price) DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT player_api_id FROM Player_Attributes WHERE overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes);
SELECT player_name, height FROM Player ORDER BY height DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT preferred_foot FROM Player_Attributes ORDER BY potential ASC LIMIT 1;

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
GROUP BY player_api_id
ORDER BY MAX(crossing) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Match AS M
JOIN Team AS T ON M.home_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
  AND M.home_team_goal - M.away_team_goal < 0
GROUP BY T.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
  AND overall_rating = (
      SELECT MAX(overall_rating)
      FROM Player_Attributes
      WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
        AND overall_rating > (
            SELECT AVG(overall_rating)
            FROM Player_Attributes
            WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
        )
  );
SELECT team_fifa_api_id FROM Team_Attributes WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND buildUpPlaySpeed < 60;

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', TA.date) = '2012'
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing > (
      SELECT SUM(TA2.buildUpPlayPassing) / COUNT(*)
      FROM Team_Attributes AS TA2
      WHERE strftime('%Y', TA2.date) = '2012'
        AND TA2.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT SUM(T2.long_shots) / COUNT(T2.player_fifa_api_id)
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id

JOIN Team AS T ON M.home_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
  AND M.home_team_goal - M.away_team_goal < 0
GROUP BY T.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
  AND overall_rating > (
      SELECT AVG(overall_rating)
      FROM Player_Attributes
      WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
  )
  AND overall_rating = (
      SELECT MAX(overall_rating)
      FROM Player_Attributes
      WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', TA.date) = '2012'
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing > (
      SELECT SUM(TA2.buildUpPlayPassing) / COUNT(T2.team_long_name)
      FROM Team AS T2
      JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA2 ON T2.team_api_id = TA2.team_api_id
      WHERE strftime('%Y', TA2.date) = '2012'
        AND TA2.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT SUM(T2.long_shots) / COUNT(T2.player_fifa_api_id) AS avg_long_shots
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.height > 180
GROUP BY P.player_name
ORDER BY SUM(PA.heading_accuracy) / COUNT(PA.player_fifa_api_id) DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT T1.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T1
JOIN Team_Attributes AS T2
    ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
WHERE T2.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
  AND T2.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND T2.date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  AND T2.chanceCreationPassing < (
        SELECT SUM(T3.chanceCreationPassing) / COUNT(T3.id)
        FROM Team_Attributes AS T3
        WHERE T3.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
          AND T3.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
          AND T3.date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  )
ORDER BY T2.chanceCreationPassing DESC;
SELECT team_short_name FROM Team WHERE team_long_name = 'Queens Park Rangers';

SELECT pa.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Franco Zennaro';

SELECT T2.heading_accuracy 
FROM Player AS T1 
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id 
WHERE T1.player_name = 'Francois Affolter' 
  AND T2.date = '2014-09-18 00:00:00'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Match

FROM Player AS T1

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating > 80
  AND strftime('%Y', PA.date) BETWEEN '2008' AND '2010';

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name
FROM Team AS T

SELECT Country.name
FROM League

FROM Match
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id

FROM Match AS M
JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id

FROM League AS L
JOIN Match AS M ON L.id = M.league_id
WHERE M.season = '2008/2009'

ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id

SELECT pa.preferred_foot
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo';

FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Dorlan Pabon';

FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.overall_rating = 77

FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id

SELECT T2.defensive_work_rate
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.player_name = 'Kevin Berigaud'

SELECT AVG(PA.overall_rating) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
JOIN Player AS P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic'
  AND substr(PA.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21';

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Match m
  ON p.player_api_id IN (
      m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4,
      m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8,
      m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
      m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4,
      m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8,
      m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11)
JOIN Country c
  ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE c.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name, C.name AS country
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
JOIN Match M ON P.player_api_id IN (
    M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4,
    M.home_player_5, M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8,
    M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
    M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4,
    M.away_player_5, M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8,
    M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
)
JOIN Country C ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE PA.vision > 89;

SELECT c.name
FROM Country c
JOIN Match m ON c.id = m.country_id
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id IN (
    m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
    m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
    m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
    m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
)
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY AVG(p.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

FROM account

       END AS higher_unemployment_year
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.district_id)
FROM district AS T1
JOIN client AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
WHERE T2.gender = 'F'
  AND T1.A11 > 6000
  AND T1.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client 
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE client.gender = 'M' 
  AND district.A3 = 'North Bohemia' 
  AND district.A11 > 8000;

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
JOIN client AS T3 ON T2.client_id = T3.client_id
JOIN district AS T4 ON T3.district_id = T4.district_id
WHERE T3.gender = 'F'
  AND T3.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date)
                       FROM client
                       WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND T4.A11 = (SELECT MIN(T6.A11)
                FROM client AS T5
                JOIN district AS T6 ON T5.district_id = T6.district_id
                WHERE T5.gender = 'F'
                  AND T5.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date)
                                       FROM client
                                       WHERE gender = 'F'));

FROM account AS a
JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A15 = (
      SELECT MAX(A15)
      FROM district

SELECT COUNT(*)

FROM card;

SELECT card.type
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id

WHERE client.client_id = 13539;

SELECT district.A3 
FROM client 
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS percentage_female
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A11 > 10000;

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1.date) AS INTEGER) = 1997 THEN T1.amount ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1.date) AS INTEGER) = 1996 THEN T1.amount ELSE 0 END))
    * 100.0
    / SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1.date) AS INTEGER) = 1996 THEN T1.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan AS T1
JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
JOIN disp AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id
JOIN client AS T4 ON T3.client_id = T4.client_id
WHERE T4.gender = 'M'
  AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1.date) AS INTEGER) IN (1996, 1997);

SELECT (SELECT SUM(A16) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'north Bohemia') 
     - (SELECT SUM(A16) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'east Bohemia') AS crime_difference

FROM disp

    l.duration,
    l.status
FROM loan AS l
JOIN disp AS d ON l.account_id = d.account_id

JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member

SELECT T3.city, T3.state
FROM member AS T1
JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id
JOIN zip_code AS T3 ON T1.zip = T3.zip_code
WHERE T2.department = 'Electrical and Computer Engineering Department'
  AND T1.position = 'Member';

SELECT T3.last_name
FROM event AS T1
JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event
JOIN member AS T3 ON T2.link_to_member = T3.member_id
WHERE T1.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer' AND T3.position = 'Member';

SELECT event_name 
FROM event 
WHERE type = 'Game' 
  AND status = 'Closed' 
  AND event_date BETWEEN '2019-03-15' AND '2020-03-20';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, a.link_to_event
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
WHERE e.approved = 'true'
  AND e.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-01-10' AND '2019-11-19';

SELECT member.email
FROM expense
JOIN member ON expense.link_to_member = member.member_id
WHERE expense.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-09-10' AND '2019-11-19'
  AND expense.cost > 20;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM member 
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id 
WHERE major.major_name = 'Education' 
  AND major.college = 'College of Education & Human Services' 
  AND member.position = 'Member';

SELECT expense_description
FROM expense
GROUP BY expense_description
HAVING SUM(cost) / COUNT(expense_id) > 50;

SELECT SUM(e.cost) / COUNT(ev.event_id) AS average_amount_paid
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE m.position != 'Member';

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name
FROM member AS T1
JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
GROUP BY T1.member_id
ORDER BY MAX(T2.cost) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name, T1.phone
FROM member AS T1
INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
WHERE T2.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense)

SELECT major.major_name, major.department
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.first_name = 'Garrett' AND member.last_name = 'Gerke';

SELECT m.last_name, m.phone
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.major_name = 'Elementary Education';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, ma.college
FROM member m
JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
WHERE m.position = 'Secretary';

SELECT SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent, e.event_name
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Speaker Gifts'
GROUP BY e.event_name;

SELECT T2.city
FROM member AS T1
JOIN zip_code AS T2 ON T1.zip = T2.zip_code
WHERE T1.first_name = 'Garrett' AND T1.last_name = 'Gerke'

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
GROUP BY s.id, s.full_name
HAVING COUNT(s.full_name) > 15;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero 
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id 
WHERE colour.colour = 'Blue';

SELECT s.superhero_name, s.height_cm
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
ORDER BY s.height_cm DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero 
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id 
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
        * 100 / COUNT(s.id) AS percentage_bad_superheroes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS marvel_bad_count
FROM superhero AS s
INNER JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
INNER JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id;
SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'Star Trek';

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.id = 75;

SELECT AVG(T1.weight_kg)
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1.gender_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.gender = 'Female';

SELECT T1.superhero_name 
FROM superhero AS T1 
JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id 
WHERE T2.race = 'Alien'

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND c.colour = 'No Colour';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Demi-God'
LIMIT 5;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm = 185
  AND r.race = 'Human';

SELECT T1.power_name
FROM superpower AS T1
INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.power_id
WHERE T2.hero_id = 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(id) / SUM(skin_colour_id = 1)
FROM superhero;

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT superhero.height_cm
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Amber';

SELECT c2.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c1 ON s.skin_colour_id = c1.id
JOIN colour c2 ON s.eye_colour_id = c2.id
WHERE c1.colour = 'Gold';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Vampire';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percent
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT 
    superhero_name,
    SUM(height_cm) / COUNT(*) AS average_height
FROM superhero
GROUP BY superhero_name;
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id = 1;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT publisher.publisher_name
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE superhero.id = 38;

SELECT a.alignment, sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race 
FROM superhero 
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id 
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id 
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id 
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue' AND gender.gender = 'Male';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN superhero.gender_id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(superhero.id) AS female_percentage
FROM superhero
WHERE superhero.alignment_id = 2;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green'
  AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm) 
FROM superhero AS T1 
INNER JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id 
INNER JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id 
WHERE T2.race <> 'Human' 
AND T3.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM hero_attribute 
JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id 
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed' 
  AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler';
SELECT hero_id FROM hero_attribute WHERE attribute_value = (SELECT MIN(attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute)

SELECT T1.full_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.weight_kg < 100 AND T2.colour = 'brown'

SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT T1.hero_id 
FROM hero_power AS T1 
INNER JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T1.power_id = T2.id 
WHERE T2.power_name = 'Intelligence'

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatient_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
        / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT P.ID,
       STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.RVVT = '+';

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday)) - MIN(STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG >= 200
);

SELECT T1.Date, STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS Average_Age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y-%m-%d', T2.Date) BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT T1.`aCL IgM`
FROM Examination AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T2.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T1.`Examination Date` = '1993/11/12';

SELECT T1.SEX 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.GPT = '9' AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12'

SELECT strftime('%Y', T1.Date) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T2
JOIN Laboratory AS T1 ON T2.ID = T1.ID
WHERE T1.UA = '8.4' AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
ORDER BY T1.`First Date`
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(ID)
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND YEAR(Birthday) = 1964
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.`ANA Pattern` = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 1.2;

SELECT T1.SEX 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS' 
  AND T3.CRP > 2 
  AND T3.CRE = 1 
  AND T3.LDH = 123

SELECT Symptoms
FROM Examination
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
GROUP BY Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(Symptoms) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') / COUNT(SEX) * 100 AS percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE YEAR(Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET'
  AND T1.Admission = '-';

SELECT DATEDIFF(e.`Examination Date`, p.`First Date`) 
FROM Examination e 
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID 
WHERE e.ID = 821298;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Birthday = '1982/04/01' AND L.ALP < 300;

SELECT T1.ID, T2.TP - 8.5 AS TP_Deviation
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.TP > 8.5;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND (T2.ALB <= 3.5 OR T2.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC

SELECT T1.ID, 
       CASE 
           WHEN T2.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' 
           ELSE 'No' 
       END AS 'Albumin within normal range'
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(T3.UA)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T3.Date = (
    SELECT MAX(Date)
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE ID = T3.ID
)
AND ((T1.SEX = 'M' AND T3.UA < 8.0)
  OR (T1.SEX = 'F' AND T3.UA < 6.5))

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F')
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT T1.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 
GROUP BY T1.SEX

SELECT P.ID, L.`T-CHO`
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
ORDER BY L.`T-CHO` DESC, P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.APTT > 45 AND T2.Thrombosis = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' 
  AND T2.`U-PRO` > 0 
  AND T2.`U-PRO` < 30;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.IGG > 900 AND T2.IGG < 2000
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 
  AND (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(T1.Birthday)) < 70

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND T1.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RF < 20
  AND (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(T1.Birthday)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'APS'
  AND Laboratory.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T3.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.Thrombosis = 0

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T3.SC170 IN ('negative', '0') 
    AND T1.SEX = 'F' 
    AND T2.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.`First Date`) < '2000';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.DNA < 8 AND T1.Description IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) * 1.0 / (
    SELECT COUNT(ID)
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE GOT >= 60
)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.GOT >= 60 AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT Birthday FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE GOT >= 60) ORDER BY Birthday DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.`First Date` 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.LDH < 500 
ORDER BY T2.LDH DESC 
LIMIT 1
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY ALB DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' 
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5 
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5 
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
ORDER BY T3.`aCL IgA` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND T2.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT Diagnosis 
FROM Patient 
WHERE ID = (
    SELECT ID 
    FROM Laboratory 
    WHERE TG < 200 
    ORDER BY TG DESC 
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(atom.atom_id)
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T3.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id = T3.atom_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '='

SELECT T2.element, T3.element
FROM connected AS T1
INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
INNER JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY T1.molecule_id ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT T1.molecule_id, T1.label
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN bond AS b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected)
  AND atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected AS c
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = '='
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.atom_id
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id2 = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.atom_id = (SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'pb');

SELECT COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id), 5) AS proportion
FROM bond b

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_cons AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_cons AS (
    SELECT cz.Segment,
           SUM(cz.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(cz.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_2013 cz
    JOIN min_cons m
      ON cz.Segment = m.Segment AND cz.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY cz.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    -- Total consumption per customer for 2013, paid in CZK, per segment
    SELECT y.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c
      ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
lowest_per_segment AS (
    -- Lowest (annual) consumption value in each segment
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    -- Annual average consumption of the customer(s) with the lowest
    -- consumption in each segment = total consumption per year / number
    -- of customers with the lowest consumption in each segment
    SELECT z.Segment,
           SUM(z.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(z.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM czk_2013 z
    JOIN lowest_per_segment l
      ON l.Segment = z.Segment
     AND l.min_consumption = z.total_consumption
    GROUP BY z.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

    GROUP BY y.CustomerID
) AS T;

SELECT DISTINCT T3.Description
FROM yearmonth AS T1
JOIN transactions_1k AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
JOIN products AS T3 ON T2.ProductID = T3.ProductID
WHERE SUBSTR(T1.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
  AND SUBSTR(T1.Date, 5, 2) = '09';

SELECT DISTINCT T3.Country
FROM yearmonth AS T1
JOIN transactions_1k AS T2 
    ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
JOIN gasstations AS T3 
    ON T2.GasStationID = T3.GasStationID
WHERE SUBSTR(T1.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
  AND SUBSTR(T1.Date, 5, 2) = '06';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT y.CustomerID) AS num_customers
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  AND y.Consumption > 1000;

SELECT CustomerID
FROM transactions_1k
WHERE Date = '2012-08-25'
GROUP BY CustomerID
ORDER BY SUM(Price) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT g.Country
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25'
ORDER BY t.Time ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.Segment
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
ORDER BY y.Date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.Country
FROM transactions_1k AS T1
JOIN gasstations AS T2
  ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID
WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-24'
  AND T1.Time = '12:42:00';

SELECT c.Currency
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE y.Date LIKE '%201306%'
  AND y.Consumption = 214582.17;

SELECT g.Country
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-24'
  AND t.Price = 548.4;

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN t.CustomerID END) 
       / COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID) AS percentage
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25';

SELECT
    (SELECT SUM(t.Amount)
     FROM transactions_1k t
     WHERE t.CustomerID = 38508) AS total_amount_spent_at_gas_stations,
    (SELECT SUM(ym.Consumption)
     FROM yearmonth ym
     WHERE ym.CustomerID = 38508
       AND ym.Date = '201201') AS amount_spent_in_january_2012;

SELECT
    c.CustomerID                                  AS top_customer,
    SUM(t.Price)                                  AS total_spent,
    SUM(t.Price) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Amount)            AS avg_price_per_single_item,
    c.Currency
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c
    ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Currency
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT P.player_api_id
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
GROUP BY P.player_api_id
ORDER BY MAX(PA.crossing) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Match AS M
JOIN Team AS T ON M.home_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
  AND M.home_team_goal - M.away_team_goal < 0
GROUP BY T.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
  AND overall_rating = (
      SELECT MAX(overall_rating)
      FROM Player_Attributes
      WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
  );

SELECT team_fifa_api_id
FROM Team_Attributes
WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50
  AND buildUpPlaySpeed < 60;

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', TA.date) = '2012'
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing > (
      SELECT SUM(TA2.buildUpPlayPassing) / COUNT(T2.team_long_name)
      FROM Team_Attributes AS TA2
      JOIN Team AS T2 ON T2.team_api_id = TA2.team_api_id
      WHERE strftime('%Y', TA2.date) = '2012'
        AND TA2.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT SUM(T2.long_shots) / COUNT(T2.player_fifa_api_id) AS avg_long_shots
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2
  ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag';

SELECT T1.player_name
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.height > 180
GROUP BY T1.player_name
ORDER BY SUM(T2.heading_accuracy) / COUNT(T2.player_fifa_api_id) DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
  AND TA.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND TA.date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  AND TA.chanceCreationPassing < (
      SELECT AVG(chanceCreationPassing)
      FROM Team_Attributes
      WHERE buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
        AND date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
        AND date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  )
ORDER BY TA.chanceCreationPassing DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT pa.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Franco Zennaro';

SELECT pa.heading_accuracy
FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Francois Affolter'
  AND pa.date = '2014-09-18 00:00:00';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_matches
FROM Match
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id
WHERE Match.season = '2015/2016'
  AND League.name = 'Scotland Premier League';

SELECT T1.preferred_foot
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.birthday = (SELECT MAX(birthday) FROM Player)

SELECT League.name
FROM League
JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id
WHERE Country.name = 'Netherlands';

SELECT SUM(Match.home_team_goal) / COUNT(DISTINCT Match.id) AS average_home_team_goal
FROM Match
JOIN Country ON Match.country_id = Country.id
WHERE Country.name = 'Poland'
  AND Match.season = '2010/2011';

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.overall_rating > 80
  AND strftime('%Y', pa.date) BETWEEN '2008' AND '2010';

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.preferred_foot = 'left';

SELECT ta.buildUpPlayPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes ta
JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_short_name = 'CLB';

SELECT T.team_short_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlayPassing > 70;

SELECT Country.name
FROM League
JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id
WHERE League.name = 'Italy Serie A';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Match
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id
WHERE League.name = 'Germany 1. Bundesliga'
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', Match.date) BETWEEN '2008-08' AND '2008-10';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name IN ('Alexis', 'Ariel Borysiuk', 'Arouna Kone')
GROUP BY P.player_name
ORDER BY MAX(PA.crossing) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_matches
FROM Match AS M
JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE L.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League'
  AND SUBSTR(M.date, 1, 7) = '2009-04';

SELECT L.name
FROM League L
JOIN Match M ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE M.season = '2008/2009'
GROUP BY L.id, L.name
ORDER BY COUNT(M.match_api_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(T2.overall_rating) / COUNT(T2.id) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2
    ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.birthday) < '1986';

SELECT pa.preferred_foot
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo';

SELECT MAX(T1.overall_rating) AS highest_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Dorlan Pabon';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA
    ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating = 77
  AND PA.date LIKE '2016-06-23%'
ORDER BY P.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT pa.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore'
  AND pa.date LIKE '2015-05-01%';

SELECT PA.defensive_work_rate
FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
JOIN Player AS P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Kevin Berigaud'
  AND PA.date = '2013-02-22 00:00:00';

SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic'
  AND substr(pa.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21';

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Match m 
    ON p.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
        m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
        m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
        m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
    )
JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE c.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name, c.name AS country
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
JOIN Match m ON p.player_api_id IN (
    m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
    m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
    m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
    m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
)
JOIN Country c ON c.id = m.country_id
WHERE pa.vision > 89;

SELECT c.name
FROM Country AS c
JOIN Match AS m ON m.country_id = c.id
JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
        m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10,
        m.home_player_11, m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4,
        m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9,
        m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
     )
GROUP BY c.name
HAVING AVG(p.weight) = (
    SELECT MAX(t.avg_weight)
    FROM (
        SELECT AVG(p2.weight) AS avg_weight
        FROM Country AS c2
        JOIN Match AS m2 ON m2.country_id = c2.id
        JOIN Player AS p2 ON p2.player_api_id IN (
            m2.home_player_1, m2.home_player_2, m2.home_player_3, m2.home_player_4, m2.home_player_5,
            m2.home_player_6, m2.home_player_7, m2.home_player_8, m2.home_player_9, m2.home_player_10,
            m2.home_player_11, m2.away_player_1, m2.away_player_2, m2.away_player_3, m2.away_player_4,
            m2.away_player_5, m2.away_player_6, m2.away_player_7, m2.away_player_8, m2.away_player_9,
            m2.away_player_10, m2.away_player_11
        )
        GROUP BY c2.name
    ) AS t
);

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team T
JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

SELECT AVG(P.height) AS average_height
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Match AS M ON P.player_api_id = M.home_player_1
JOIN Country AS C ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE C.name = 'Italy';

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE height > 180
ORDER BY player_name
LIMIT 3;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN strength > 80 AND stamina > 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
FROM Player_Attributes;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS eligible_accounts
FROM account AS a
INNER JOIN district AS d
        ON a.district_id = d.district_id
INNER JOIN loan AS l
        ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
  AND l.status IN ('A', 'C');

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' 
         ELSE '1996' 
       END AS higher_unemployment_year
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_male_customers
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND d.A11 > 8000;

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - d.A11 AS gap
FROM account a
JOIN disp dp    ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN client c   ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(c2.birth_date) 
                      FROM client c2 
                      WHERE c2.gender = 'F')
  AND d.A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district);

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND SUBSTR(a.date, 1, 4) = '1993'
  AND l.amount = (
      SELECT MAX(l2.amount)
      FROM loan l2
      WHERE l2.duration > 12
  );

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account AS a
JOIN trans AS t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND t.balance > 3000;

SELECT account.date
FROM account
JOIN trans ON account.account_id = trans.account_id
WHERE trans.amount = 840
  AND trans.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT MAX(t.amount) AS max_transaction_amount
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN card c ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Litomerice'
  AND account.date LIKE '1996%';

SELECT 
    c.client_id        AS account_holder,
    a.account_id,
    a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN disp     d  ON d.account_id  = a.account_id
JOIN client   c  ON c.client_id   = d.client_id
JOIN district di ON di.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'                                -- account holder = person who owns the account
  AND di.A3 = 'east Bohemia'                          -- region filter
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1995 AND 2000;

SELECT account.account_id, account.date
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A3 AS district
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
GROUP BY d.A3
ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts_opened
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    ORDER BY A16 DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id) AS approved_loans
FROM loan AS l
JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND l.date >= '1995-01-01'
  AND l.date <= '1997-12-31'
  AND l.status = 'A';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 1
  AND l.status IN ('C', 'D');

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_male_clients
FROM client
WHERE gender = 'M'
  AND district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    ORDER BY A15 DESC
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM card 
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id 
WHERE card.type = 'gold' 
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id
FROM "order" o
JOIN account a   ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d  ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'   -- household payment
  AND d.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT account.account_id
FROM account
JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id
WHERE card.type = 'gold';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT trans.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM trans
JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND trans.bank = 'AB';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_clients
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Hl.m. Praha'
  AND c.gender = 'M';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'gold' AND issued < '1998-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percent_gold_before_1998
FROM card;

SELECT card.type
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE disp.client_id = 13539;

SELECT d.A3 AS region
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.client_id = 3541;

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS pct_women
FROM client c
JOIN disp d     ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a  ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A11 > 10000;

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER) = 1997 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
   - SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER) = 1996 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END))
   * 100.0
   / SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER) = 1996 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN A3 = 'north Bohemia' THEN A16 ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN A3 = 'east Bohemia'   THEN A16 ELSE 0 END) AS crime_difference
FROM district
WHERE A3 IN ('north Bohemia', 'east Bohemia');

SELECT strftime('%Y', client.birth_date) AS birth_year
FROM disp
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE disp.account_id = 130
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT
    l.amount   AS debt_amount,
    l.payments AS monthly_payment,
    l.status   AS payment_status
FROM loan AS l
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM disp AS d
    WHERE d.client_id = 992
      AND d.account_id = l.account_id
);

SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid
FROM trans AS t
JOIN disp AS d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.client_id = 617
  AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1998';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Beroun'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', account.date) AS INTEGER) > 1996;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id) AS num_loan_accounts
FROM loan l
JOIN account a
  ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration = 24
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE';

SELECT DISTINCT
    c.client_id,
    (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) AS age
FROM client AS c
JOIN disp AS d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN card AS cd ON cd.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE cd.type = 'gold'      -- high-level credit card
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';     -- eligible for loans

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_students
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE major.college = 'College of Engineering';

SELECT COUNT(T1.link_to_member) AS num_students
FROM attendance AS T1
JOIN event AS T2 ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_id
WHERE T2.event_name = "Women's Soccer";

SELECT m.phone
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.event_name = "Women's Soccer";

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
ORDER BY COUNT(a.link_to_event) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.event_id) AS num_events
FROM event AS T1
JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event
JOIN member AS T3 ON T2.link_to_member = T3.member_id
WHERE T3.first_name = 'Sacha'
  AND T3.last_name = 'Harrison'
  AND YEAR(T1.event_date) = 2019;

SELECT COUNT(event_id) AS num_meetings
FROM event
WHERE type = 'Meeting'
  AND event_id IN (
      SELECT link_to_event
      FROM attendance
      GROUP BY link_to_event
      HAVING COUNT(link_to_member) > 10
  );

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event AS e
JOIN attendance AS a 
    ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
WHERE e.type != 'Fundraiser'
GROUP BY e.event_name
HAVING COUNT(e.event_id) > 20;

SELECT COUNT(e.event_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_name) AS average_attendance
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.type = 'Meeting'
  AND YEAR(e.event_date) = 2020;

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatient_male_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_male_count,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >
             SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        THEN 'In-patients'
        ELSE 'Outpatients'
    END AS more_group,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
    , 2) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT T1.ID,
       YEAR(current_timestamp) - YEAR(T1.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

SELECT 
    T1.ID,
    T2.ALP,
    CASE 
        WHEN T2.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS ALP_Within_Normal_Range
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

    L.ID,
    L.TP - 8.5 AS TP_Deviation
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID

FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND (L.ALB <= 3.5 OR L.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT
    P.ID,
    P.Birthday,
    L.ALB,
    CASE
        WHEN L.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS Albumin_Within_Normal_Range
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(T.UA) AS average_UA_index
FROM (
    -- Get each patient's latest laboratory examination UA value
    SELECT L.ID, L.UA
    FROM Laboratory AS L
    WHERE L.Date = (
        SELECT MAX(L2.Date)
        FROM Laboratory AS L2
        WHERE L2.ID = L.ID
    )
) AS T
JOIN Patient AS P ON T.ID = P.ID
-- Keep only patients whose latest UA is within the normal range for their sex
WHERE (P.SEX = 'M' AND T.UA < 8.0)
   OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND T.UA < 6.5);

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
