    SELECT MAX(ALB)
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_male_patients
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.ALB > 3.5
  AND L.ALB < 5.5
  AND L.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
ORDER BY T3.`aCL IgA` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND T3.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG < 200
ORDER BY T2.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T3.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) /
       (SELECT COUNT(T1.atom_id)
        FROM atom AS T1
        JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
        WHERE T2.label = '+')
FROM bond AS T3
JOIN molecule AS T4 ON T3.molecule_id = T4.molecule_id
WHERE T4.label = '+';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom AS a
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
) AS dbl ON a.molecule_id = dbl.molecule_id;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.element
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 
  ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id OR T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id2
WHERE T2.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
WHERE T3.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT atom.element
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY atom.element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-'
  AND bond.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond.bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE bond.molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond.bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT 
    a.molecule_id,
    CASE WHEN m.label = '+' 
         THEN 'Carcinogenic' 
         ELSE 'Not carcinogenic' 
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR004';

SELECT CASE
         WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes'
         ELSE 'No'
       END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id = (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT element
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected)
  AND atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE bond.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND bond.bond_type = '#';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.atom_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.element = 'pb';

SELECT CAST(COUNT(T1.bond_id) AS REAL) * 100 / (
    SELECT CAST(COUNT(T2.atom_id) AS REAL)
    FROM connected AS T2
             JOIN atom AS A1 ON T2.atom_id = A1.atom_id
             JOIN atom AS A2 ON T2.atom_id2 = A2.atom_id
    GROUP BY A1.element, A2.element
    ORDER BY COUNT(T2.atom_id) DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS percentage
FROM connected AS T1;

SELECT
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
        / COUNT(b.bond_id),
        5
    ) AS carcinogenic_single_bond_percentage
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
JOIN bond ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(*) >= 1 AS has_both_cl_and_c
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND (
        (a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c')
     OR (a1.element = 'c'  AND a2.element = 'cl')
      );

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected AS c
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_single_bond_molecules
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
        WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) AS element_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND SUBSTR(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4';

SELECT 
    m.molecule_id,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic'
        ELSE 'Non-Carcinogenic'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a 
    ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'ca';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN label = '+' THEN 'Yes, TR151 is carcinogenic'
         ELSE 'No, TR151 is not carcinogenic'
       END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND c.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT T1.atom_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'c'
  AND T2.label = '-';

SELECT
    m.molecule_id,
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count,
    CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
         ELSE 'non-carcinogenic'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN bond b
       ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND b.bond_type = ' = '
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl' 
  AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT a.atom_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM   atom a
JOIN   molecule m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
JOIN   bond b     ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE  m.molecule_id = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM molecule 
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT molecule_id 
    FROM atom 
    WHERE element = 's'
) 
AND molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT molecule_id 
    FROM bond 
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
);

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'cl'
  AND molecule.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a      ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b      ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 's'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(a.molecule_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(c.atom_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(a2.molecule_id) AS atom_count
        FROM atom a2
        JOIN molecule m2 ON a2.molecule_id = m2.molecule_id
        WHERE m2.label = '+'
        GROUP BY a2.molecule_id
    ) c
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T1.element = 'o' AND T3.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM molecule
WHERE label = '-'
  AND molecule_id IN (
      SELECT molecule_id
      FROM bond
      WHERE bond_type = '#'
  );

SELECT T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.SOC = 65
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT satscores.sname
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND schools.Magnet = 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY st.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT sc.District, AVG(s.AvgScrRead) AS avg_reading_score
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY sc.District
ORDER BY avg_reading_score DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM satscores 
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode 
WHERE schools.StatusType = 'Merged' 
  AND schools.County = 'Alameda' 
  AND satscores.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT s.sname, sch.CharterNum, s.AvgScrWrite, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS rank
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND sch.CharterNum IS NOT NULL;

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
WHERE s.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.School, s.FundingType
HAVING AVG(sc.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800
  AND f.`High Grade` = 12;

SELECT schools.School, schools.DOCType
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Locally Funded'
GROUP BY frpm.CDSCode
HAVING AVG(frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` - frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
    SELECT AVG(`Enrollment (K-12)` - `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
    FROM frpm
    WHERE `Charter Funding Type` = 'Locally Funded'
)

SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS `Eligible Free Rate (K-12)`
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS free_rate
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND s.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson';

SELECT s.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(T2.NumTstTakr)
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.OpenDate) = '1980'
  AND T1.County = 'Fresno';

SELECT s.AvgScrWrite, sc.City
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.School
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.DOC = 31
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.MailStreet, sc.sname
FROM satscores sc
JOIN schools s ON sc.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY sc.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM satscores 
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode 
WHERE (satscores.AvgScrRead + satscores.AvgScrMath + satscores.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500 
  AND schools.MailCity = 'Lakeport';

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez');

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'San Joaquin'
  AND Charter = 1
  AND Virtual = 'P';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM frpm 
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode 
WHERE schools.County = 'Los Angeles' 
  AND schools.Charter = 0 
  AND frpm.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18;

SELECT COUNT(CDSCode)
FROM schools
WHERE strftime('%Y', OpenDate) BETWEEN '2000' AND '2005'
  AND FundingType = 'Directly Funded'
  AND County = 'Stanislaus';

SELECT County
FROM schools
WHERE SOC = 11
  AND strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989'
GROUP BY County
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MAX(closure_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS closure_count
        FROM schools
        WHERE SOC = 11
          AND strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989'
        GROUP BY County
    ) AS counts
);

SELECT T2.School, T1.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` * 100
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.GSserved = 'K-9' AND T2.County = 'Los Angeles';

SELECT s.GSserved
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.City = 'Adelanto'
GROUP BY s.GSserved
ORDER BY COUNT(s.GSserved) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.City, f.`Low Grade`, s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.State = 'CA'
ORDER BY s.Latitude ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.City) AS number_of_cities, s.City, COUNT(s.CDSCode) AS number_of_schools
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1
  AND s.GSserved = 'K-8'
  AND f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types'
GROUP BY s.City;

SELECT T1.`District Code`,
       T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` * 100 AS `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine';

SELECT AdmEmail1, AdmEmail2
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND District = 'San Bernardino City Unified'
  AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'
  AND SOC = 62
  AND DOC = 54;

SELECT posts.Title
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT MAX(p.AnswerCount) AS AnswerCount
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE p.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL;

SELECT posts.Body
FROM tags
JOIN posts ON tags.ExcerptPostId = posts.Id
WHERE tags.TagName = 'bayesian';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS BadgeCount
FROM badges
JOIN users ON badges.UserId = users.Id
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
  AND YEAR(badges.Date) = 2011;

SELECT AVG(p.Score) AS AverageScore
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT COUNT(comments.Id) AS NumberOfComments
FROM posts
JOIN comments ON posts.Id = comments.PostId
WHERE posts.ViewCount = 1910;

SELECT c.Text
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.ParentId = 107829 AND p.CommentCount = 1;

SELECT users.DisplayName
FROM comments
JOIN users ON comments.UserId = users.Id
WHERE comments.Text = 'thank you user93!';

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.LastEditorUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Open source tools for visualizing multi-dimensional data';

SELECT SUM(v.BountyAmount) AS TotalBountyAmount
FROM posts p
JOIN votes v ON p.Id = v.PostId
WHERE p.Title LIKE '%data%';

SELECT T1.DisplayName
FROM users AS T1
JOIN votes AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId
JOIN posts AS T3 ON T2.PostId = T3.Id
WHERE T2.BountyAmount = 50
  AND T3.Title LIKE '%variance%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.Id) AS NumUsers
FROM users u
JOIN badges b1 ON u.Id = b1.UserId AND b1.Name = 'Teacher'
JOIN badges b2 ON u.Id = b2.UserId AND b2.Name = 'Supporter'
WHERE u.Location LIKE '%New York%';

SELECT u.Id, u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN postHistory ph ON ph.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Views >= 1000
GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName
HAVING COUNT(ph.Id) = COUNT(DISTINCT ph.PostId);

SELECT u.Id, u.DisplayName, b.Name AS BadgeName
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Id IN (
    SELECT UserId
    FROM comments
    GROUP BY UserId

        SELECT MAX(cnt)

            SELECT COUNT(Id) AS cnt
            FROM comments
            GROUP BY UserId
        ) AS comment_counts
    )
);

SELECT ph.PostHistoryTypeId,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.UserId) AS UniqueCommentingUsers
FROM postHistory ph
LEFT JOIN comments c ON c.PostId = ph.PostId
WHERE ph.PostId = 3720

SELECT posts.Score, postLinks.LinkTypeId
FROM posts
JOIN postLinks ON posts.Id = postLinks.PostId
WHERE posts.Id = 395;

SELECT SUM(users.UpVotes) / COUNT(posts.OwnerUserId) AS average_up_votes,
       SUM(users.Age) / COUNT(posts.OwnerUserId) AS average_age
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.UserId) AS NumberOfUsers
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE b.Name = 'Announcer';

SELECT badges.Date
FROM badges
JOIN users ON badges.UserId = users.Id
WHERE users.Location = 'Rochester, NY';

SELECT T2.Text
FROM posts AS T1
JOIN comments AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.PostId
WHERE T1.CreationDate = '2010-07-19 19:37:33.0'

SELECT DISTINCT u.Age
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId
WHERE u.Location = 'Vienna, Austria';

SELECT badges.Name
FROM badges
JOIN users ON badges.UserId = users.Id
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'Sharpie';

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM votes WHERE YEAR(CreationDate) = 2010) /
       (SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM votes WHERE YEAR(CreationDate) = 2011) AS vote_ratio;

SELECT Tags
FROM posts
WHERE OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id

FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.UserId)
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE b.Name = 'Commentator'
  AND strftime('%Y', b.Date) = '2014';
SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM posts WHERE CreationDate BETWEEN '2010-07-21 00:00:00' AND '2010-07-21 23:59:59';

SELECT b.Name
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id

SELECT u.DisplayName, u.WebsiteUrl
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id

SELECT p.Title,
       COUNT(ph.Id) AS PostHistoryCount,
       p.LastEditDate

WHERE p.Title = 'What is the best introductory Bayesian statistics textbook?'

SELECT u.LastAccessDate, u.Location
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE b.Name = 'Outliers';

SELECT c.PostId, b.Name
FROM comments c
JOIN badges b ON c.UserId = b.UserId
WHERE c.UserDisplayName = 'Samuel'
  AND YEAR(c.CreationDate) = 2013
  AND YEAR(b.Date) = 2013;

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId

    SELECT MAX(badge_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(Name) AS badge_count

    ) AS counts
);

SELECT MIN(v.CreationDate)
FROM votes v
JOIN users u ON v.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'chl';

SELECT c.Segment, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
FROM yearmonth ym
JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.Segment

LIMIT 1;

WITH customer_consumption AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
min_consumption AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM customer_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT cc.Segment,
           SUM(cc.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(cc.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM customer_consumption cc
    JOIN min_consumption mc
      ON cc.Segment = mc.Segment AND cc.total_consumption = mc.min_total
    GROUP BY cc.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_diff,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_diff,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME_diff;

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER) = 1997 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) 
     - SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER) = 1996 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) 
    * 100.0 
    / SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER) = 1996 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M';

SELECT strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS birth_year
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.account_id)

JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE'

    SELECT MAX(symptom_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(Symptoms) AS symptom_count
        FROM Examination
        JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
        WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE'

JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID

  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.IGG >= 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.IGG > 900 AND T2.IGG < 2000 AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(T1.Birthday)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.KCT = '+';

SELECT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20
  AND (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(Patient.Birthday)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Symptoms = 'thrombosis' AND T3.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Examination.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND YEAR(Patient.`First Date`) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT MULTIPLY(DIVIDE(COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN Patient.ID END), COUNT(Patient.ID)), 1.0) AS percentage
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;
SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT >= 60

SELECT MIN(T2.`First Date`)
FROM Patient AS T2
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T1 ON T2.ID = T1.ID
WHERE T1.LDH < 500
  AND T1.LDH = (SELECT MAX(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500);
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB = (SELECT MAX(ALB) FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5) AND ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Laboratory.ALB > 3.5
  AND Laboratory.ALB < 5.5
  AND Laboratory.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT DISTINCT t1.ID
FROM Laboratory AS t1
JOIN Examination AS t2 ON t1.ID = t2.ID
WHERE t1.CRE < 1.5
  AND t2.`aCL IgA` = (SELECT MAX(`aCL IgA`) FROM Examination);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID)
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Examination E ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND E.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.TG < 200
ORDER BY l.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT bond_type FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND atom.element = 'cl';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(T1.atom_id)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T1.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS T4 ON T1.atom_id = T4.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T4.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T3.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(T1.atom_id)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '=';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9'
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT a1.atom_id AS atom1, c.atom_id2 AS atom2
FROM atom a1
JOIN connected c ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY a.element
LIMIT 3;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT b.bond_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY b.bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT DISTINCT atom.element
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.molecule_id = 'TR004';

SELECT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
JOIN (
    SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS double_bond_count
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY molecule_id
) b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.double_bond_count = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM bond
        WHERE bond_type = ' = '
        GROUP BY molecule_id
    ) t
);

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(b.bond_id) = (
    SELECT COUNT(b2.bond_id)
    FROM molecule m2
    JOIN bond b2 ON m2.molecule_id = b2.molecule_id
    WHERE m2.label = '+'
      AND b2.bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY m2.molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(b2.bond_id) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT T2.atom_id2 
FROM atom AS T1 
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id 
WHERE T1.element = 'pb'
UNION
SELECT T2.atom_id 
FROM atom AS T1 
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id2 
WHERE T1.element = 'pb';

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(T1.bond_id) / (SELECT COUNT(bond_id) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
GROUP BY T2.element, T3.element
HAVING COUNT(T1.bond_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(C1.bond_id) AS cnt
        FROM connected AS C1
        JOIN atom AS A1 ON C1.atom_id = A1.atom_id
        JOIN atom AS A2 ON C1.atom_id2 = A2.atom_id
        GROUP BY A1.element, A2.element
    ) AS max_counts
)

SELECT ROUND(SUM(m.label = '+') * 100 / COUNT(b.bond_id), 5) AS proportion
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element)
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) = 2 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND a.element IN ('cl', 'c');

SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-' AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id, m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) AS tally
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND substr(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY a.element;

SELECT T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'ca';

SELECT SUM(b.bond_type = ' = ') / COUNT(b.bond_id) AS percent
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR047';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' AND c.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT atom.atom_id
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c' AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) 
     FROM bond 
     WHERE bond.molecule_id = 'TR006' 
       AND bond.bond_type = ' = ') AS double_bond_count,
    CASE 
        WHEN (SELECT label 
              FROM molecule 
              WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006') = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
        ELSE 'non-carcinogenic'
    END AS carcinogenic_status;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id)
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT T1.atom_id, COUNT(T3.bond_type) AS bond_type_count
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR346'
GROUP BY T1.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM molecule 
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's') 
  AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ');

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'cl' AND molecule.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND T2.atom_id2 = 'TR000_4';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.label
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T4 ON T3.bond_id = T4.bond_id
WHERE T2.element = 's' AND T4.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(a.atom_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(atom_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(a2.atom_id) AS atom_count
        FROM molecule m2
        JOIN atom a2 ON m2.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id
        WHERE m2.label = '+'
        GROUP BY m2.molecule_id
    ) AS counts
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS total_molecules
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 'o' AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s
  ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.SOCType = 'Continuation School'
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.sname
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND sc.Magnet = 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY st.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    sc.District,
    AVG(s.AvgScrRead) AS avg_reading_score
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc 
    ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY sc.District
ORDER BY avg_reading_score DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(s.CDSCode)
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS t
  ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND s.County = 'Alameda'
  AND t.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT 
    s.sname,
    s.AvgScrWrite,
    sc.CharterNum
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc 
    ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE st.cname = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.CDSCode, s.School, s.FundingType
HAVING AVG(st.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT
    s.School,
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.State,
    s.Zip
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f
    ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800
  AND s.School LIKE '%High%';

SELECT T2.School, T2.DOCType
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
      SELECT AVG(T3.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T3.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm AS T3
      INNER JOIN schools AS T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode
      WHERE T4.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  );

SELECT
    s.School,
    f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT 
    T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 1.0 / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS Free_Rate
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' 
    AND T2.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson';

SELECT s.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(T2.NumTstTakr) AS average_test_takers
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.County = 'Fresno'
  AND strftime('%Y', T1.OpenDate) = '1980';

SELECT 
    s.AvgScrWrite,
    sc.City
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.School,
       f.`Enrollment (K-12)`
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f
  ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = '31'                      -- State Special Schools
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    satscores.sname,
    schools.MailStreet
FROM satscores
JOIN schools 
    ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY 
    satscores.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT COUNT(T2.cds) AS total_schools
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.MailCity = 'Lakeport'
  AND (T2.AvgScrRead + T2.AvgScrMath + T2.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500;

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez');

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE Virtual = 'P'
  AND Charter = 1
  AND County = 'San Joaquin';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_schools
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND T2.Charter = 0
  AND T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18;

SELECT COUNT(CDSCode) AS total_schools
FROM schools
WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman'
  AND CharterNum = '00D4';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_schools
FROM schools
WHERE FundingType = 'Directly Funded'
  AND County = 'Stanislaus'
  AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31';

SELECT 
    T1.County
FROM schools AS T1
WHERE T1.SOC = 11
  AND strftime('%Y', T1.ClosedDate) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989'
GROUP BY T1.County
ORDER BY COUNT(T1.CDSCode) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` * 100.0 AS `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)`
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f 
    ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.GSserved = 'K-9'
  AND s.County = 'Los Angeles';

SELECT GSserved
FROM schools
WHERE City = 'Adelanto'
GROUP BY GSserved
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    s.City,
    f.`Low Grade`,
    s.School
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f
    ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.State = 'CA'
ORDER BY CAST(s.Latitude AS REAL) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_magnet_k8_multiple_provision_schools
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1
  AND s.GSserved = 'K-8'

SELECT 
    f.`District Code`,
    f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` * 100 AS `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s 
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine';

SELECT 
    AdmEmail1, 
    AdmEmail2, 
    AdmEmail3
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND District = 'San Bernardino City Unified'
  AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'

  AND AdmEmail2 IS NOT NULL

SELECT DisplayName
FROM users
ORDER BY Views DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT posts.Title
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT MAX(p.AnswerCount) AS AnswerCount
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL;

SELECT posts.Body

SELECT COUNT(*) AS badge_count

JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id

SELECT AVG(p.Score) AS AverageScore

WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT COUNT(c.Id) AS CommentCount
FROM posts p

WHERE p.ViewCount = 1910;

SELECT c.Text
FROM comments c

SELECT users.DisplayName
FROM comments

SELECT users.DisplayName AS Editor
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.LastEditorUserId = users.Id

SELECT SUM(v.BountyAmount) AS TotalBountyAmount
FROM votes v
JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.Title LIKE '%data%';

SELECT users.DisplayName
FROM votes
JOIN posts ON votes.PostId = posts.Id

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM users
WHERE Location LIKE '%New York%'
  AND Id IN (SELECT UserId FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Supporter')
  AND Id IN (SELECT UserId FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Teachers');

SELECT DISTINCT T1.UserId
FROM postHistory AS T1
JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.Id
WHERE T2.Views >= 1000
GROUP BY T1.UserId, T1.PostId
HAVING COUNT(*) = 1;

SELECT u.Id AS UserId,
       u.DisplayName,
       b.Name AS BadgeName,
       b.Date AS BadgeDate
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Id IN (
        SELECT c.UserId
        FROM comments c
        WHERE c.UserId IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY c.UserId
        HAVING COUNT(c.Id) = (
            SELECT MAX(total)

WITH customer_totals AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer (only customers paying in CZK)
    SELECT ym.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_totals AS (
    -- Minimum total consumption within each segment
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM customer_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_customers AS (
    -- Customers tied for the lowest consumption, per segment
    SELECT ct.Segment,
           SUM(ct.total_consumption) AS segment_total,
           COUNT(ct.CustomerID)      AS num_customers
    FROM customer_totals ct
    JOIN min_totals mt
      ON ct.Segment = mt.Segment
     AND ct.total_consumption = mt.min_consumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
),
annual_averages AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption / number of lowest-consumption customers
    SELECT Segment,
           segment_total * 1.0 / num_customers AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest_customers
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_averages WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

JOIN client   c  ON dp.client_id   = c.client_id
JOIN district d  ON c.district_id  = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND d.A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district);

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T2.duration > 12
  AND T2.amount = (SELECT MAX(amount)
                   FROM loan
                   WHERE duration > 12)
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.date) = '1993';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
INNER JOIN trans AS T2 
    ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.date) < '1997'
  AND T2.balance > 3000;

SELECT A.date AS account_opened_date
FROM trans T
JOIN account A ON T.account_id = A.account_id
WHERE T.amount = 840
  AND T.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT MAX(trans.amount) AS biggest_transaction_amount
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN trans ON account.account_id = trans.account_id
WHERE card.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Litomerice'
  AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1996';

SELECT
    client.client_id,
    account.account_id,
    account.frequency
FROM account
JOIN disp     ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN client   ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN district ON district.district_id = account.district_id
WHERE disp.type = 'OWNER'
  AND district.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(account.date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1995 AND 2000

SELECT account.account_id, account.date
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A3 AS district_name
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')   -- active/running contracts
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(account_id) AS num_accounts_opened
FROM account
WHERE district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    ORDER BY A16 DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id) AS approved_loans
FROM loan AS l
JOIN account AS a 
    ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.status = 'A';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account.account_id) AS num_running_accounts
FROM account
JOIN loan ON account.account_id = loan.account_id
WHERE account.district_id = 1
  AND loan.status IN ('C', 'D');

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_male_clients
FROM client
WHERE gender = 'M'
  AND district_id = (
      SELECT district_id
      FROM district
      ORDER BY A15 DESC
      LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_gold_owner_cards
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE card.type = 'gold'
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id

JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_male_clients
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Hl.m. Praha'
  AND client.gender = 'M';

SELECT c.type
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE d.client_id = 13539;

SELECT district.A3
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.client_id = 3541;

SELECT 
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) * 1.0 
    / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS percentage_women
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE di.A11 > 10000;

SELECT
    ( SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
      -
      SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
    ) * 100.0
    / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM disp d
    JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    WHERE d.account_id = l.account_id
      AND c.gender = 'M'
);

SELECT 
    (SELECT SUM(A16) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'north Bohemia') 
    - 
    (SELECT SUM(A16) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'east Bohemia') 
    AS crime_difference_1996;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT 
    c.client_id,
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount        AS loan_amount,
    l.payments      AS monthly_payment,
    l.duration,
    l.status,
    CASE l.status
        WHEN 'A' THEN 'Contract finished - no problems'
        WHEN 'B' THEN 'Contract finished - loan NOT paid (debt)'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'Loan running - payments OK'
        WHEN 'D' THEN 'Loan running - client in debt'
    END AS payment_status
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 992;

SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.client_id = 617

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Beroun'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS loan_account_count

    ON loan.account_id = account.account_id

SELECT

JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 
             SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
            THEN 'More male in-patients'
        ELSE 'More male outpatients'
    END AS Answer,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT 
    P.ID, 
    STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.RVVT = '+';

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(strftime('%Y', Birthday)) - MIN(strftime('%Y', Birthday)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG >= 200
);

SELECT 
    T1.Date, 
    strftime('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
    /
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l
    ON p.ID = l.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS average_age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT e.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND p.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND e.`Examination Date` = '1993/11/12';

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date = '1992-06-12'
  AND T2.GPT = '9';

SELECT strftime('%Y', T1.Date) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.UA = '8.4'
  AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND E.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(ID), ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(ID) AS num_patients
FROM Examination
WHERE Thrombosis = 2
  AND ANA = 'S'
  AND `aCL IgM` > (
        SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) + AVG(`aCL IgM`) * 0.2
        FROM Examination
      );

SELECT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'Behcet'
  AND T1.Admission = '-'

SELECT JULIANDAY(`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(`First Date`)
FROM Examination
JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = 821298;

SELECT 
    P.ID,
    L.ALP,
    CASE 
        WHEN L.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' 
        ELSE 'No' 
    END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT 
    P.ID,
    L.TP,
    L.TP - 8.5 AS TP_Deviation
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'
  AND L.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND (L.ALB <= 3.5 OR L.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    Patient.ID,
    Patient.Birthday,
    Laboratory.Date,
    Laboratory.ALB,
    CASE 
        WHEN Laboratory.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 
            THEN 'Within normal range'
        ELSE 'Outside normal range'
    END AS Albumin_Status
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(L.UA) AS avg_ua
FROM Laboratory AS L
INNER JOIN Patient AS P
        ON L.ID = P.ID
INNER JOIN (
        SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS LatestDate
        FROM Laboratory
        GROUP BY ID
    ) AS Latest
        ON L.ID = Latest.ID
       AND L.Date = Latest.LatestDate
WHERE (P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA < 8.0)
   OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA < 6.5);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND T2.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(SEX = 'M') > SUM(SEX = 'F') AS answer
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE CRE >= 1.5
);

SELECT 
    p.SEX,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS Patients
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT  L.ID,
        L.`T-CHO`
FROM    Laboratory AS L
        INNER JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE   L.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC          -- earliest birthday = oldest patient
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.APTT > 45
  AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` < 30;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.IGG > 900 
  AND T1.IGG < 2000 
  AND T2.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+'
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND Examination.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'APS'
  AND T2.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) 
FROM Patient 
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.SM IN ('-', '+-') 
  AND Examination.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT E.ID
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Laboratory AS L
    ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) 
FROM Patient 
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-') 
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.DNA < 8
  AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Laboratory.GOT >= 60 AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
               THEN Laboratory.ID END) * 1.0
    /
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Laboratory.GOT >= 60
               THEN Laboratory.ID END) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID;

SELECT MAX(T2.Birthday)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MIN(P.`First Date`)
FROM Patient AS P
WHERE P.ID = (
    SELECT L.ID
    FROM Laboratory AS L
    WHERE L.LDH < 500
    ORDER BY L.LDH DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' 
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5 
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5 
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(E.ANA)
FROM Examination AS E
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.CRE < 1.5
  AND E.`aCL IgA` = (
        SELECT MAX(E2.`aCL IgA`)
        FROM Examination AS E2
        JOIN Laboratory AS L2 ON E2.ID = L2.ID
        WHERE L2.CRE < 1.5
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND T3.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG < 200
ORDER BY T2.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-' AND a.element = 'cl';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
       / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonded
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id
JOIN bond ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(atom.atom_id) 
    AS carbon_percentage
FROM atom
WHERE atom.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT bond.molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond.bond_type = '='
);

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a
    ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN molecule AS m
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'        -- single bond
  AND m.label = '-'            -- not carcinogenic
ORDER BY m.molecule_id         -- alphabetical order by molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond.bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE bond.molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond.bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT 
    b.bond_type,
    c.atom_id,
    c.atom_id2
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c 
    ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' 
        ELSE 'No' 
    END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id = (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
WHERE a.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT c.atom_id  FROM connected c)
  AND a.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT c.atom_id2 FROM connected c);

SELECT a1.atom_id  AS atom1_id,
       a1.element  AS atom1_element,
       a2.atom_id  AS atom2_id,
       a2.element  AS atom2_element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c1 ON b.bond_id = c1.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c1.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c1.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.atom_id2
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.element = 'pb';

SELECT 100.0 * MAX(cnt) / SUM(cnt) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
) AS combos;

SELECT ROUND(
           CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 AS REAL) 
           / COUNT(b.bond_id),
           5
       ) AS carcinogenic_proportion
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) AS num_elements
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT 
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) >= 1 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS has_cl_and_c
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 
    ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 
    ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND (
        (T2.element = 'cl' AND T3.element = 'c')
     OR (T2.element = 'c'  AND T3.element = 'cl')
      );

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond.molecule_id) 
FROM bond 
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id 
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-' AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id,
       CASE 
           WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
           WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic'
       END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT T1.element, COUNT(T1.element)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.label = '+'
  AND substr(T1.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY T1.element;

SELECT DISTINCT m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'ca';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS atom_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND c.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT T1.atom_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'c' AND T2.label = '-'

SELECT
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count,
    m.label          AS carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
  AND b.bond_type = ' ='
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_chlorine_bonds
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl'
  AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT 
    a.atom_id, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond b 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM molecule 
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id 
        FROM atom 
        WHERE element = 's'
      )
  AND molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id 
        FROM bond 
        WHERE bond_type = ' = '
      );

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'cl'
  AND molecule.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT a.molecule_id
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
  AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_4';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T1.element = 's'
  AND T3.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(a.atom_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) AS num_molecules
FROM atom AS T1
INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T1.element = 'o'
  AND T3.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id) AS num_non_carcinogenic
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT frpm.`School Name`, frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate FROM frpm INNER JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode WHERE schools.SOCType = 'Continuation School' AND frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 0 ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC LIMIT 3
SELECT T1.sname FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500 AND T2.Magnet = 1
SELECT s.Phone FROM schools s JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds ORDER BY t.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500;
SELECT s.District, AVG(sc.AvgScrRead) AS avg_read FROM satscores sc JOIN schools s ON sc.cds = s.CDSCode WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active' GROUP BY s.District ORDER BY avg_read DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(T1.cds) FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.StatusType = 'Merged' AND T2.County = 'Alameda' AND T1.NumTstTakr < 100;
SELECT s.sname, sc.CharterNum, s.AvgScrWrite FROM satscores s JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC
SELECT s.sname, sc.FundingType FROM satscores AS s JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode WHERE s.cname = 'Riverside' GROUP BY s.sname HAVING SUM(s.AvgScrMath) / COUNT(s.sname) > 400;

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Monterey' AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800 AND f.`School Type` LIKE 'High Schools%';

SELECT s.School, s.DOCType FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded' AND (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (SELECT AVG(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) FROM frpm f2 JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally funded');
SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate FROM frpm ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9

SELECT frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` FROM frpm JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode WHERE (schools.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND schools.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson') OR (schools.AdmFName2 = 'Kacey' AND schools.AdmLName2 = 'Gibson') OR (schools.AdmFName3 = 'Kacey' AND schools.AdmLName3 = 'Gibson')
SELECT s.AdmEmail1 FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT AVG(T2.NumTstTakr) FROM schools AS T1 JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T1.County = 'Fresno' AND strftime('%Y', T1.OpenDate) = '1980';
SELECT s.AvgScrWrite, sc.City FROM satscores s JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode ORDER BY s.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT s.School FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.DOC = 31 ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT s.sname, sc.MailStreet FROM satscores s JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode ORDER BY s.AvgScrMath DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM satscores t INNER JOIN schools s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode WHERE (t.AvgScrRead + t.AvgScrMath + t.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500 AND s.MailCity = 'Lakeport';

SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE ((AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson') OR (AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson') OR (AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson')) AND ((AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez') OR (AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez') OR (AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez'))

WITH base AS (SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, ym.CustomerID AS CustomerID, ym.Consumption AS Consumption FROM yearmonth ym JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'), lowest AS (SELECT Segment, MIN(Consumption) AS min_cons FROM base GROUP BY Segment), avg_cons AS (SELECT b.Segment AS Segment, SUM(b.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT b.CustomerID) AS annual_avg FROM base b JOIN lowest l ON b.Segment = l.Segment AND b.Consumption = l.min_cons GROUP BY b.Segment) SELECT (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM, (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM, (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

WITH min_cons AS (
    -- Find the minimum consumption value in 2013 for each segment (CZK customers only)
    SELECT c.Segment, MIN(y.Consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
seg_avg AS (
    -- Annual average = SUM(consumption) / COUNT(customers) among the lowest-consumption rows per segment
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(y.Consumption) / COUNT(y.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    JOIN min_cons m ON c.Segment = m.Segment
                   AND y.Consumption = m.min_consumption
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_diff,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_diff,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME_diff;

WITH czk2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, y.Consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
seg_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(Consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
seg_avg AS (
    SELECT s.Segment,
           SUM(s.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(s.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk2013 s
    JOIN seg_min m
      ON s.Segment = m.Segment AND s.Consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY s.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

       l.payments AS monthly_payment,
       l.duration AS loan_duration

WITH magnet_frpm AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_multiple_provision_types

    JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode

      AND s.GSserved = 'K-8'
      AND f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types'
),
city_schools AS (
    SELECT City, COUNT(CDSCode) AS num_schools_k8
    FROM schools
    WHERE GSserved = 'K-8'
    GROUP BY City
)
SELECT
    m.num_multiple_provision_types,
    c.City,
    c.num_schools_k8,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM city_schools) AS num_cities
FROM magnet_frpm m
CROSS JOIN city_schools c;

WITH czk_totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN yearmonth AS y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM czk_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_customers AS (
    SELECT t.Segment,
           SUM(t.total_consumption) AS sum_consumption,
           COUNT(*) AS num_customers
    FROM czk_totals AS t
    JOIN min_totals AS m
      ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_total
    GROUP BY t.Segment
),
annual_averages AS (
    SELECT Segment, sum_consumption / num_customers AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest_customers
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_averages WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per CZK customer, by segment
    SELECT
        c.CustomerID,
        c.Segment,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y
      ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
seg_min AS (
    -- Minimum total consumption in each segment
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
least AS (
    -- Customers at the minimum: their summed consumption and their count
    SELECT
        z.Segment,
        SUM(z.total_consumption) AS least_total,
        COUNT(*)                 AS least_count
    FROM czk_2013 z
    JOIN seg_min m
      ON z.Segment = m.Segment
     AND z.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY z.Segment
),
seg_avg AS (
    -- Annual average = total of lowest-consumption customers / their count
    SELECT Segment, least_total * 1.0 / least_count AS annual_avg
    FROM least
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS "SME - LAM",
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS "LAM - KAM",
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS "KAM - SME";
