INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.publisher_name = 'DC Comics';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT MIN(ha2.attribute_value)
      FROM hero_attribute ha2
      JOIN attribute a2 ON ha2.attribute_id = a2.id
      WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
  );

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN T2.alignment = 'Bad' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(T1.id) AS percentage,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.alignment = 'Bad' AND T3.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 END) AS marvel_bad_count
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN alignment AS T2 ON T1.alignment_id = T2.id
INNER JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id;
SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'Star Trek';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE full_name IS NULL;

SELECT colour.colour
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE superhero.id = 75;

SELECT AVG(T1.weight_kg) 
FROM superhero AS T1 
INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1.gender_id = T2.id 
WHERE T2.gender = 'Female'

SELECT superhero.superhero_name 
FROM superhero 
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id 
WHERE race.race = 'Alien';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND c.colour = 'No Colour';

SELECT superhero.full_name
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE race.race = 'Demi-God'
LIMIT 5;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm = 185
  AND r.race = 'Human';

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE hp.hero_id = 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(superhero.id) / SUM(superhero.skin_colour_id = 1) AS average
FROM superhero;

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT superhero.height_cm
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Amber';

SELECT c2.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c1 ON s.skin_colour_id = c1.id
JOIN colour c2 ON s.eye_colour_id = c2.id
WHERE c1.colour = 'Gold';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Vampire';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN gender.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM superhero
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Emil Blonsky') 
     - (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') AS weight_difference;

SELECT 
    superhero_name,
    SUM(height_cm) / COUNT(id) AS average_height
FROM superhero
GROUP BY superhero_name;
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id = 1;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT publisher.publisher_name
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE superhero.id = 38;

SELECT a.alignment, s.power_name
FROM superhero sh
JOIN alignment a ON sh.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON sh.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower s ON s.id = hp.power_id
WHERE sh.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT T1.superhero_name 
FROM superhero AS T1 
JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id 
WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue' AND gender.gender = 'male';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.gender_id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(T1.id) AS percentage
FROM superhero AS T1
WHERE T1.alignment_id = 2

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.skin_colour_id = T2.id
JOIN alignment AS T3 ON T1.alignment_id = T3.id
WHERE T2.colour = 'Green' AND T3.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm) 
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id
WHERE T2.race <> 'Human' AND T3.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ha.hero_id) AS fastest_superheroes
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND ha.attribute_value = 100;
SELECT hero_id FROM hero_attribute WHERE attribute_value = (SELECT MIN(attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute);

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100 AND c.colour = 'brown';

SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN race AS r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT T1.hero_id 
FROM hero_power AS T1 
INNER JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T1.power_id = T2.id 
WHERE T2.power_name = 'Intelligence'

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatient_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT
    T1.ID,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RVVT = '+';

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ALB < 3.5
GROUP BY T1.ID;

SELECT MAX(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday)) - MIN(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG >= 200

SELECT T1.Date,
       (strftime('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday)) AS Age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
       SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday))
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT T2.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12';

SELECT T1.SEX 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.GPT = '9' 
  AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12'

SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Date) - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.UA = '8.4'
  AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21'

SELECT T1.Diagnosis 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27' 
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID)
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.ANA = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 1.2;

SELECT SEX
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE CRP > 2 AND CRE = 1 AND LDH = 123
    INTERSECT
    SELECT ID
    FROM Examination
    WHERE Diagnosis = 'PSS'
)

SELECT Symptoms 
FROM Examination 
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE' 
GROUP BY Symptoms 
ORDER BY COUNT(Symptoms) DESC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'Behcet'
  AND T1.Admission = '-'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997';

SELECT JULIANDAY(`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(`First Date`) AS days_before_evaluation
FROM Examination
JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = 821298
ORDER BY `Examination Date`
LIMIT 1;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500

SELECT T1.ID 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01' 
  AND T2.ALP < 300

SELECT T1.ID, T2.TP, T2.TP - 8.5
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.TP > 8.5

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND (T2.ALB <= 3.5 OR T2.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC

SELECT 
    T1.ID, 
    T1.Birthday, 
    T2.ALB,
    CASE 
        WHEN T2.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' 
        ELSE 'No' 
    END AS 'Albumin within normal range'
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1982'

SELECT AVG(T1.UA)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Date = (
    SELECT MAX(T3.Date)
    FROM Laboratory AS T3
    WHERE T3.ID = T1.ID
)
AND (
    (T2.SEX = 'M' AND T1.UA < 8.0)
    OR (T2.SEX = 'F' AND T1.UA < 6.5)
)

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND T2.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') AS Result
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT Patient.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID) 
FROM Laboratory 
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 
GROUP BY Patient.SEX;

SELECT P.ID, L.`T-CHO`
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.APTT > 45 AND T3.Thrombosis = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);

SELECT T1.Diagnosis 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE 0 < T1.`U-PRO` AND T1.`U-PRO` < 30 
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.IGG > 900 AND T2.IGG < 2000 AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.CRP = '+'
  AND T2.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.KCT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.RF < 20
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'APS' AND T2.C4 > 10

SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T3.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0') 
AND T1.SEX = 'F' 
AND T3.Symptoms IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-') 
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.`First Date`) < '2000';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.DNA < 8
  AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN T1.ID END) * 1.0 / COUNT(T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MAX(P.Birthday)
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GOT >= 60;

SELECT T1.`First Date` 
FROM Patient AS T1 
WHERE T1.ID = (
    SELECT ID 
    FROM Laboratory 
    WHERE LDH < 500 
    ORDER BY LDH DESC 
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT Date 
FROM Laboratory 
WHERE ALB = (
    SELECT MAX(ALB) 
    FROM Laboratory 
    WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
  AND T3."aCL IgA" = (SELECT MAX("aCL IgA") FROM Examination)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 AND T3.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%'
SELECT Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG < 200 ORDER BY TG DESC LIMIT 1);

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) 
FROM molecule AS T1 
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id 
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(connected.atom_id)
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.atom_id) AS carbon_percentage
FROM atom AS T1
WHERE T1.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
);

SELECT DISTINCT T2.element
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 
  ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id OR T1.atom_id2 = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
WHERE T3.label = '-'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.element
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY T1.element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T4 ON T3.bond_id = T4.bond_id
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T4.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY T1.molecule_id
LIMIT 3

SELECT DISTINCT bond_type
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_type ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' 
         ELSE 'No' 
       END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id = (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected AS c
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' 
  AND b.molecule_id = 'TR041';

SELECT b.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS double_bond_count
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = '='
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
ORDER BY double_bond_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.atom_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T1.element = 'pb'

WITH bond_elements AS (
    SELECT c.bond_id, a1.element AS elem1, a2.element AS elem2
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
),
top_combo AS (
    SELECT elem1, elem2
    FROM bond_elements
    GROUP BY elem1, elem2
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 100.0 *
       (SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM bond_elements
        WHERE elem1 = (SELECT elem1 FROM top_combo)
          AND elem2 = (SELECT elem2 FROM top_combo))
       /
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS pct_most_common_combo;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id)
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element)
FROM atom
JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT label
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
   OR molecule_id = 'TR001'
   OR molecule_id = 'TR002';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM connected AS T1 
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id 
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8' AND T2.element = 'cl'
INTERSECT
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM connected AS T1 
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id 
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8' AND T2.element = 'c'

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '#'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM bond AS T1
INNER JOIN molecule AS T2
    ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.bond_type = '-'
  AND T2.label = '-';

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    m.molecule_id,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
        ELSE 'non-carcinogenic'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT atom.element, COUNT(atom.element) 
FROM atom 
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id 
WHERE molecule.label = '+' 
  AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4' 
GROUP BY atom.element;

SELECT T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'ca';

SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id) 
FROM atom 
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id 
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT T2.molecule_id
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2
  ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_1'
  AND T2.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS num_double_bonds,
       molecule.label      AS carcinogenic_label

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, c.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.TotalConsumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS AnnualAvg
    FROM totals t
    JOIN mins m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.TotalConsumption = m.MinConsumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS Diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS Diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS Diff_KAM_SME;

WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
minc AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM yearly
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT y.Segment, SUM(y.total_consumption) AS sum_cons, COUNT(y.CustomerID) AS num_cust
    FROM yearly y
    JOIN minc m ON y.Segment = m.Segment AND y.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY y.Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT Segment, CAST(sum_cons AS REAL) / num_cust AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

WITH continuation AS (
    SELECT CDSCode
    FROM schools
    WHERE SOCType = 'Continuation High School'
)
SELECT T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN continuation AS C ON T1.CDSCode = C.CDSCode
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3

WITH active_schools AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, District
    FROM schools
    WHERE StatusType = 'Active'
),
district_avg AS (
    SELECT s.District, AVG(st.AvgScrRead) AS AvgReadingScore
    FROM satscores st
    JOIN active_schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
    GROUP BY s.District
)
SELECT District
FROM district_avg
WHERE AvgReadingScore IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY AvgReadingScore DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores st ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Alameda' AND s.StatusType = 'Merged' AND st.NumTstTakr < 100

SELECT s.sname, sc.CharterNum, s.AvgScrWrite,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS writing_rank
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY writing_rank;

WITH AvgConsumption AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, SUM(t.TotalConsumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS AnnualAvgConsumption
    FROM (
        SELECT ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
        FROM yearmonth ym
        JOIN customers c2 ON ym.CustomerID = c2.CustomerID
        WHERE c2.Currency = 'CZK'
          AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
        GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
    ) t
    JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    JOIN (
        SELECT c.Segment, MIN(t2.TotalConsumption) AS MinTotalConsumption
        FROM (
            SELECT ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
            FROM yearmonth ym
            JOIN customers c2 ON ym.CustomerID = c2.CustomerID
            WHERE c2.Currency = 'CZK'
              AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
            GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
        ) t2
        JOIN customers c ON t2.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
        GROUP BY c.Segment
    ) m ON c.Segment = m.Segment AND t.TotalConsumption = m.MinTotalConsumption
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAvgConsumption FROM AvgConsumption WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT AnnualAvgConsumption FROM AvgConsumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvgConsumption FROM AvgConsumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT AnnualAvgConsumption FROM AvgConsumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvgConsumption FROM AvgConsumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT AnnualAvgConsumption FROM AvgConsumption WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

WITH triple_bond AS (
    SELECT bond_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE molecule_id = 'TR041' AND bond_type = '#'
),
bond_atoms AS (
    SELECT atom_id AS atom
    FROM connected
    WHERE bond_id IN (SELECT bond_id FROM triple_bond)
    UNION
    SELECT atom_id2 AS atom
    FROM connected
    WHERE bond_id IN (SELECT bond_id FROM triple_bond)
)
SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id, a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN bond_atoms ba ON a.atom_id = ba.atom;

    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id

SELECT CASE a.element
    WHEN 'cl' THEN 'Chlorine'
    WHEN 'c' THEN 'Carbon'
    WHEN 'h' THEN 'Hydrogen'
    WHEN 'o' THEN 'Oxygen'
    WHEN 's' THEN 'Sulfur'
    WHEN 'n' THEN 'Nitrogen'
    WHEN 'p' THEN 'Phosphorus'
    WHEN 'na' THEN 'Sodium'
    WHEN 'br' THEN 'Bromine'
    WHEN 'f' THEN 'Fluorine'
    WHEN 'i' THEN 'Iodine'
    WHEN 'sn' THEN 'Tin'
    WHEN 'pb' THEN 'Lead'
    WHEN 'te' THEN 'Tellurium'
    WHEN 'ca' THEN 'Calcium'
    ELSE a.element
END AS element_name
FROM atom a
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, m.label

SELECT atom.molecule_id, COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS atom_count
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
GROUP BY atom.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(atom.atom_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(t.atom_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT atom.molecule_id, COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS atom_count
        FROM atom
        JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
        WHERE molecule.label = '+'
        GROUP BY atom.molecule_id
    ) AS t
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS total_molecules

    a.atom_id IN (

    OR a.atom_id IN (
      SELECT c.atom_id2
      FROM connected c
      JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
      WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '

  );

WITH per_customer AS (

    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID

    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_total AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS mt
    FROM per_customer
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT pc.Segment, pc.CustomerID, pc.total
    FROM per_customer pc
    JOIN min_total m ON pc.Segment = m.Segment AND pc.total = m.mt
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT Segment, SUM(total) * 1.0 / COUNT(CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM lowest
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_consumption END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS diff_SME_LAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_consumption END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_consumption END) AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM annual_avg;

WITH cust_cons AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_cons
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_cons AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_cons) AS min_total
    FROM cust_cons
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_seg AS (
    SELECT cc.Segment, SUM(cc.total_cons) * 1.0 / COUNT(cc.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM cust_cons cc
    JOIN min_cons m ON cc.Segment = m.Segment AND cc.total_cons = m.min_total
    GROUP BY cc.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH per_customer AS (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM per_customer
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT pc.Segment, SUM(pc.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM per_customer pc
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON pc.Segment = m.Segment AND pc.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY pc.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total_consumption) AS total, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM totals t
    JOIN mins m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT Segment, total * 1.0 / cnt AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, ym.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
segmin AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
mincust AS (
    SELECT t.Segment AS Segment, SUM(t.TotalConsumption) AS TotalSum, COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount
    FROM totals t
    JOIN segmin sm ON t.Segment = sm.Segment AND t.TotalConsumption = sm.MinConsumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (sme.TotalSum * 1.0 / sme.CustomerCount) - (lam.TotalSum * 1.0 / lam.CustomerCount) AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (lam.TotalSum * 1.0 / lam.CustomerCount) - (kam.TotalSum * 1.0 / kam.CustomerCount) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (kam.TotalSum * 1.0 / kam.CustomerCount) - (sme.TotalSum * 1.0 / sme.CustomerCount) AS KAM_minus_SME
FROM mincust sme
JOIN mincust lam ON lam.Segment = 'LAM'
JOIN mincust kam ON kam.Segment = 'KAM'

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Admission = '+' THEN p.ID END) >= COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Admission = '-' THEN p.ID END)
      THEN 'in-patient'
    ELSE 'outpatient'
  END AS more_common,
  ROUND(
    (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Admission = '+' THEN p.ID END) -
     COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Admission = '-' THEN p.ID END)) * 100.0
    / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Admission = '-' THEN p.ID END), 2

FROM Patient p

WITH SegmentConsumption AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT Segment
FROM SegmentConsumption
WHERE TotalConsumption = (SELECT MIN(TotalConsumption) FROM SegmentConsumption)

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
minvals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, AVG(t.TotalConsumption) AS AnnualAvgConsumption
    FROM totals t
    JOIN minvals m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.TotalConsumption = m.MinConsumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAvgConsumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT AnnualAvgConsumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvgConsumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT AnnualAvgConsumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvgConsumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT AnnualAvgConsumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME

    UNION SELECT m.away_player_7, m.country_id FROM Match m
    UNION SELECT m.away_player_8, m.country_id FROM Match m
    UNION SELECT m.away_player_9, m.country_id FROM Match m
    UNION SELECT m.away_player_10, m.country_id FROM Match m
    UNION SELECT m.away_player_11, m.country_id FROM Match m
)
SELECT DISTINCT hv.player_name, c.name AS country
FROM high_vision hv
JOIN player_country pc ON pc.player_api_id = hv.player_api_id
JOIN Country c ON c.id = pc.country_id

WITH country_avg_weight AS (
    SELECT c.name AS country_name, AVG(p.weight) AS average_weight
    FROM (
        SELECT country_id, home_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
    ) t
    JOIN Country c ON c.id = t.country_id
    JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = t.player_api_id
    GROUP BY c.name
)
SELECT country_name, average_weight
FROM country_avg_weight
ORDER BY average_weight DESC
LIMIT 1
